summary: Iteration 181 validated Production OS 3.1.0 additions + regression. Backend pytest 16/17 passed (94%). 1 real backend bug found: POST /api/ai/universal-command with 'aggiungi una bilancia' returns action_type 'ui_personalization' instead of 'device_added' because the 'aggiungi' branch is checked first and swallows all 'aggiungi *' commands - the 'bilancia'/'scale' branch is unreachable for phrases containing 'aggiungi'. All other endpoints work: sequence_block alert (6-lang) appears in pulse after out-of-order start and clears after correct order; sensors/live GET+POST persists oven_temp/ph and triggers oven_hot(critical, >250) + ph_low(warn, <3.8) alerts in pulse, sensors object exposed, safe values clear alerts; staffing/apply-volumes with 1 absence over total=5 returns factor=0.8, reduce_pct=20, adjusted=1 and reduces pieces 100->80 while retaining pieces_base=100; staffing/history returns 7 days; shift-assignment POST(92)->Super Saiyan/Over 9000!, PATCH(60)->Aura Bassa, DELETE ok; shift-plan lists workers with aura+6-lang label; leaderboard rank 1 title 'Master of the Shift', sorted desc; worker-aura/Michele returns aura; morning-briefing returns greeting/night_summary(list)/overall_lab_efficiency/ai_recommendation; websocket /api/ws/production-os returns letz_passive_silent + next_action_unlocked=true on target-reached, and active_alert on 'emergenza'; universal-command and PATCH/POST/DELETE shift require admin (401 anon). Frontend Capo panel: after clicking 'Open' on MikiLab section the bakomix-sense-fab is visible; clicking opens BakoMix Sixth Sense panel showing bakomix-briefing (with close), shift-power-board (crown on top scorer Michele, 2 shift-score-* sliders, shift-add-toggle visible), bakomix-staffing card 'Today 4 of 5: reduced staff' + bakomix-apply-volumes button + bakomix-staff-week chart, bakomix-sensors-live card showing Oven 230 / pH 4.1, docs-download testid present with 6 language buttons. Frontend Mohamed floor: shift-power-board present in read-only mode (no shift-add-toggle, no shift-score sliders), sequence-guard present, clicking out-of-sequence batch opens sequence-block-modal 'Batch out of sequence · This must start first: Baguette'. Full cleanup performed: batches=[], absences today deleted, sensors_live deleted, seq_block deleted, test devices/features/shifts wiped; seeded team Michele(94/streak5)/Antonio(82/streak2) intact. NOTE: Backend 3 tests initially failed under pytest -n 2 (xdist parallel) due to cross-class races on shared mongo collections (lab_shift_state / lab_sensors_live) - re-ran with -n 0 and only the real 'aggiungi bilancia' bug remained. Test file adopts a session-safe layout but the parallel default addopts of the repo (-n 2 --dist loadscope) causes flakiness for this class-sharded test module.

minor.issue: Command 'aggiungi una bilancia' returns action_type 'ui_personalization' instead of 'device_added' because the 'aggiungi'/'rubrica'/'add'/'widget' branch is evaluated before the 'bilancia'/'scale' branch; any phrase containing 'aggiungi' matches the first branch and the bilancia path is effectively unreachable. Fix: check 'bilancia'/'scale'/'waage' BEFORE the generic 'aggiungi' branch (or exclude 'bilancia' from the first branch).

action_items: Fix POST /api/ai/universal-command branch ordering so 'aggiungi una bilancia' (and 'aggiungi bilancia smart', etc.) returns action_type='device_added' with a device payload. Suggested code (server.py ~2690): move the 'bilancia/scale/waage' if-block ABOVE the 'aggiungi/rubrica/add/widget' block, or add 'and not any(k in text for k in ("bilancia","scale","waage"))' to the first branch condition.

Optional: fix pytest.ini flakiness - the test module writes to shared mongo docs (lab_shift_state, lab_sensors_live) across classes and the loadscope parallel mode causes cross-class races. Consider running iter181 with -n 0 or annotate class-level serialization.

rca of the issue: POST /api/ai/universal-command handler in /app/backend/server.py (~lines 2690-2709): the first `if "aggiungi" in text or "rubrica" in text or ...` matches ANY string containing 'aggiungi', including 'aggiungi una bilancia', and returns immediately with action_type='ui_personalization'. The second branch handling 'bilancia'/'scale'/'waage' therefore never executes for the specification's command. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $API/api/ai/universal-command -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"command_text":"aggiungi una bilancia"}'` returns `{"action_type":"ui_personalization",...}` instead of `{"action_type":"device_added","device":{...}}`. Fix: reorder the branches to check bilancia/scale/waage first, or exclude 'bilancia'/'scale' tokens from the first branch's condition.
